finding: findFiles() used fs.statSync (follows symlinks) instead of lstatSync; SKIP_DIRS matches by directory NAME only, so a symlink committed under src/ escapes the scanned tree and defeats the node_modules/dist/.git exclusions. Auditor verified: a dir containing `vendor -> <repo>/node_modules` scanned 3851 files, parsed third-party code, emitted 22 bogus H1/H2 findings, 5.66s vs 1.5s. Bounded by kernel ELOOP; no file contents echoed. Same weakness pre-exists in scripts/lint-icon-action.mjs:60.

Every test case re-walked/re-read/re-parsed the full 2174-file registry (no cross-call cache): `npm run test:lint-hooks` = 31.6s for 39 tests, ~30s of it redundant re-parsing (784ms of each 1.26s run is ts.createSourceFile). Peak RSS 331MB, fully reclaimed (no leak). The GATING command itself is only 1.45-1.56s, in line with sibling lints (lint-icon-action 0.65s, logical-direction 1.14s).
